questions.stem: A 10-year-old child has swelling and pain around the wrist joints and fingers. Classic rheumatoid nodules were seen over the spine and bony prominences of the hands. Which of the following about the management of juvenile idiopathic arthritis is false?

options.label: A
options.text: Methotrexate is used as it acts within a few days of intake

options.label: B
options.text: Abatacept and tocilizumab target specific immune system components

options.label: C
options.text: Anakinra is effective for systemic JIA

options.label: D
options.text: Corticosteroids are used for the control of uveitis
